body: NO OBJECTION; one docs consequence. The local-only, exact-hash, binaries-out-of-Git boundary is the right authority shape. Until P1 qualifies that runtime and produces real coverage/abstention receipts, the docs capability tour must label the existing deterministic provider as narrow transport/contract evidence and must not present arbitrary-prose modeling as delivered. Once qualified, the real provider path should become an end-to-end documented workflow: admitted input, pinned runtime manifest, central compile API, typed partial outcomes, exact output bundle, and one inspectable visualization. This is a content dependency for the docs successor, not a reason to delay the already approved mechanical site candidate.
